description.en: A complete gameplay system: per-character affection that is saved with the game, a heart meter HUD, script blocks, an Affection Branch story node, a scene module and an editor panel to configure everything.
description.zh-CN: 完整的玩法系统：随存档保存的角色好感度、爱心进度 HUD、脚本积木、「好感分支」剧情节点、场景模块，以及用于配置的编辑器面板。
